params.body:
The redesign of "Mijn aangeboden wagens" (#934) changed three things that dealers working the list every day noticed on 5 October 2026: the cars no longer stood newest first, the row had a lot of white space, and the bids button was hard to spot. This brings those three back to how they were before the redesign. The rest of the redesign stays: the state column, the countdown to assign a bid, and the sentence at the top.

## What changes

**Newest first again.** A list nobody sorted is ordered by start date, newest first (then by id), as it was before #934. "Wat eerst moet gebeuren" stays in the sort menu as a choice, and any choice now lasts for the session. The menu marks "Startdatum" when nothing was chosen. The sentence at the top still counts in urgency order, so "loopt nog tot morgen" names the bidding that really ends first.

**Biedingen is a filled blue button again** on every bidding row where no step is due (running, closed without a bid, done). Where a step is due (assign, release, picked up), the step is the filled button and Biedingen stays one tap next to it as a quiet action. So every row still has exactly one filled button.

**Less white space.** Car, bid and term stand next to each other again (the car column caps at 280 px). The bid is left-aligned with "excl. BTW" after the amount, as in the old table. The spare width now sits in front of the controls, and the step column moved to the left of the two one-tap actions, so on a row without a step the empty column merges into that space instead of opening a gap before the ⋯ menu. A line separates the rows on every width, as the table had.

**A sort-direction fix found on the way.** `Search::sortering` only honours the `sortorder` of a request when the session already holds one. A list that was never sorted on a column holds none, so a first ascending choice came out descending. `OfferedCars::sortMode` now writes the chosen column and direction into the session itself.

Rules R B1-1.17, B1-1.19, B1-5.13 and B1-5.14 describe the new behaviour.

## Checked

- Full phpunit suite: 2999 tests OK. `OfferedCarsListTest` and `BiddingFunnelTest` were updated for the order, the filled bids and the bid markup, and the order test now also covers urgency staying chosen and a new session starting newest first.
- PHPStan: no errors. `bin/rules-sources`: no problems. `npm run build`, vitest and eslint pass.
- Rendered with sample offers of every kind and screenshotted at 1440, 1100 and 390 px next to the version before #934: car, bid and term sit together, the rows have lines, Biedingen is blue where no step is due, and nothing scrolls sideways on a phone.
params.title: My offered cars: newest first again, Biedingen filled blue, less white space
